title_en: 1+1 APARTMENT FOR SALE IN PORCELANI AREA (BEHIND U.E.T)
description_en: We are selling a 1+1 apartment in Porcelani area. The apartment is located on the 3rd floor of an existing 5-storey building (Prefab). It has a total area of ​​54m2 organized in the living room together with the kitchen, a bedroom and a toilet. Other details: Covered with kapot system from the inside, parquet, LED lighting, electrical and plumbing work done 3 months ago. The area has all the necessary facilities nearby, such as schools/gardens/kindergartens/policlinics/hospitals/markets and many others. For more information or a visit to the property, contact us!
